department.en: Revenue Department, Govt of NCT of Delhi

summary.en: A Revenue Department certificate that you belong to a Scheduled Caste or Scheduled Tribe.
summary.hi: राजस्व विभाग का प्रमाण पत्र कि आप अनुसूचित जाति या जनजाति से हैं।
summary.hn: Revenue Department ka certificate ki aap Scheduled Caste ya Tribe se hain.

text.en: An SC/ST certificate issued in Delhi. It is also asked for by other services, for example the SC/ST/OBC merit scholarship.
You belong to a Scheduled Caste or Scheduled Tribe. A copy of an SC/ST certificate of your father, brother, sister or another paternal blood relative is the main proof.
If nobody in your family has a certificate, two government servants must certify that they know you permanently and that you belong to the named caste, with attested copies of their ID cards.
For married women, a local enquiry is held at the place of residence before marriage and after marriage.
Aadhaar. It is not compulsory: if you have none, give any one identity proof from PAN, passport, driving licence or voter card.
A copy of the SC/ST certificate of your father, brother, sister or paternal blood relative. No affidavit is needed if you attach a father's-side SC certificate issued in Delhi.
A self-declaration in the prescribed format if the relative's certificate was issued outside Delhi.
Present residence proof such as a voter card, electricity, water or telephone bill, and proof of date of birth (birth certificate, school certificate or passport).

For an SC/ST certificate from another state: self-attested application, birth or school certificate, ration card or other residence proof, and a copy of the father's certificate (show the original for examination).

14 days for an SC Delhi State certificate (service level agreement). If your certificate needs verification from the authority that issued the relative's certificate, you get it after that authority replies.
Go to the SDM of your area, or the Deputy Commissioner's office, between 10:00 AM and 1:00 PM on any working day. You can also apply online on e-District.
A local enquiry is conducted in all cases to verify your residence and caste. All documents can be self-attested.
